basic_profile.bio: Hey there! I'm Alex, a curious mind from Portland, Oregon. By day, I'm a freelance graphic designer, and by night, I'm an avid gamer and tech enthusiast. I love exploring the latest in electric vehicles and am a big fan of emerging tech companies. My weekends are usually spent playing GTA Online or getting lost in new indie games. I'm currently single and enjoy the flexibility it offers for spontaneous adventures. I tend to browse Reddit during late evenings and weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in graphic design and have always been passionate about the intersection of technology and art. I've taught myself a lot about gaming and electric vehicles through online resources and communities.
